from pathlib import Path
import os,subprocess,json,time,hashlib,urllib.parse
r=Path.cwd();s=r/'.local/step07-r9-env-io';w=r/json.loads((s/'old-workspace.json').read_text())['workspace'];helper=w/'e2e/environment.ts';new=helper.read_bytes();old=subprocess.check_output(['git','show','50fd6d84197b8c6d222f139a142ab24c918db0db:e2e/environment.ts']);config=w/'.local/io-port-control.config.ts';config.write_text("import config from "+json.dumps(str(w/'playwright.config.ts'))+";\nimport {loadE2EEnvironment} from "+json.dumps(str(helper))+";\nconst v=loadE2EEnvironment();console.log('ENV_IO_DIAGNOSTIC_PORTS '+JSON.stringify([v.API_PORT,v.WEB_PORT]));\nexport default {...config,testDir:"+json.dumps(str(w/'e2e'))+"};\n")
conf=dict(x.split('=',1)for x in(r/'.env').read_text().splitlines()if'='in x);u=urllib.parse.urlparse(conf['DATABASE_URL']);own=json.loads((s/'guard-resource-private.json').read_text());env={**os.environ,'PATH':'/Users/dingshinn/.nvm/versions/node/v22.21.1/bin:'+os.environ['PATH'],'DATABASE_URL':u._replace(path='/'+own['database']).geturl(),'NODE_OPTIONS':'--require='+str(s/'no-effects.cjs')}
for k in ['API_HOST','API_PORT','WEB_PORT','E2E_MODE']:env.pop(k,None)
p=w/'.env';assert not p.exists();p.write_text('API_PORT=4398\nWEB_PORT=5298\nENV_IO_SENTINEL=ENV_IO_CONTENT_SENTINEL\n');p.chmod(0);rows=[]
try:
 for label,content,expected in [('old-onlyDB-silent-defaults',old,0),('new-helper-onlyDB-rejects',new,1)]:
  helper.write_bytes(content);events=s/(label+'-events.txt');events.write_text('');args=['node','node_modules/@playwright/test/cli.js','test','--list','--config',str(config)];log=s/(label+'.log');t=time.time()
  with log.open('w')as f:ret=subprocess.run(args,cwd=w,env={**env,'ENV_IO_GUARD_EVENTS':str(events)},stdout=f,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT)
  b=log.read_bytes();assert ret.returncode==expected and not events.read_text();assert b'ENV_IO_CONTENT_SENTINEL'not in b
  if expected==0:assert b'ENV_IO_DIAGNOSTIC_PORTS [4310,5173]'in b and b'Total: 18 tests'in b
  else:assert b'Unable to read the optional local E2E environment file.'in b and b'ENV_IO_DIAGNOSTIC_PORTS'not in b
  rows.append({'label':label,'exitCode':ret.returncode,'expectedExit':expected,'seconds':round(time.time()-t,3),'rawPath':str(log.relative_to(r)),'rawSHA256':hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest(),'rawBytes':len(b),'guardEvents':0})
finally:
 helper.write_bytes(new);p.chmod(0o600);p.rename(w/'.local/retained-r9-unreadable-ports.env')
(s/'port-controls.json').write_text(json.dumps({'scope':'diagnostic wrapper imports exact actual Playwright config/helper and only emits ports; testDir absolute for wrapper location','fileDeclaredPorts':[4398,5298],'explicitProcessConfig':'DATABASE_URL only','oldResult':'COUNTEREXAMPLE_CAPTURED: silent defaults4310/5173; NOT PASS','newResult':'expected reject before port selection/test discovery','wrapperPath':str(config.relative_to(r)),'wrapperSHA256':hashlib.sha256(config.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'rows':rows,'newHelperRestored':helper.read_bytes()==new},indent=2)+'\n');print('real old silent4310/5173 defaults reproduced; current helper rejects; no effects')
